dictionary.MaxPlayers: Maximum number of players allowed simultaneously on the server.
dictionary.Password: Password required to join the server. Leave empty for open access.
dictionary.Public: Determines whether the server appears in the Steam public server list.
dictionary.PublicName: Public name shown in the Steam server list.
dictionary.PublicDescription: Server description shown in the public list.
dictionary.RCONPort: Port for the remote control console (RCON).
dictionary.RCONPassword: Password required to connect and execute remote commands via RCON.
dictionary.PVP: Enables Player vs Player mode (damage between players).
dictionary.SafetySystem: Enables the PVP safety system to prevent accidental attacks.
dictionary.ShowSafety: Shows the visual PVP safety indicator in the player interface.
dictionary.DoLuaChecksum: Verifies that client Lua files exactly match the server to prevent cheating mods.
dictionary.Open: If False, only whitelist or previously registered users can connect.
dictionary.AutoCreateUserInWhiteList: Automatically registers new users to the database on their first connection.
dictionary.SpeedLimit: Maximum speed limit allowed for vehicles before the server blocks them.
dictionary.BadWordPolicy: Action to take if a player says a bad word in public chat.
dictionary.MapRemotePlayerVisibility: Defines who can see other players on the game map.
dictionary.AntiCheatSafety: Disables the PVP safety anti-cheat. Recommended at 4 (Ignore) to avoid false kicks.
dictionary.AntiCheatMovement: Disables the speed/movement anti-cheat. Recommended at 4 (Ignore) if players experience lag or use fast vehicles.
dictionary.AntiCheatHit: Disables the long-range hit registration anti-cheat. Recommended at 4 (Ignore).
dictionary.AntiCheatPacket: Disables the network packet analysis anti-cheat. Recommended at 4 (Ignore).
dictionary.AntiCheatPermission: Disables the admin/moderator command permission anti-cheat. Recommended at 4 (Ignore).
dictionary.AntiCheatXP: Disables the skill experience gain anti-cheat. Recommended at 4 (Ignore).
dictionary.AntiCheatSafeHouse: Disables the safehouse protection and entry anti-cheat. Recommended at 4 (Ignore).
dictionary.AntiCheatPlayer: Disables the general player state anti-cheat. Recommended at 4 (Ignore) to prevent constant disconnects.
dictionary.AntiCheatChecksum: Disables the modified mod Lua files checksum anti-cheat. Recommended at 4 (Ignore).
dictionary.AntiCheatItem: Disables the inventory item creation/acquisition anti-cheat. Recommended at 4 (Ignore).
dictionary.Zombies: Multiplier for the total number of zombies in the world.
dictionary.ZombieConfig.PopulationMultiplier: Detailed zombie population adjustment on the map.
dictionary.ZombieConfig.Strength: Sets the physical strength of zombies (strong, normal, weak).
dictionary.ZombieConfig.Mortality: Time before an infected player dies and turns.
dictionary.ZombieConfig.Cognition: Cognitive ability of zombies (open doors, navigation, basic).
dictionary.ZombieConfig.Memory: Duration of zombie memory when chasing or hearing noise.
dictionary.ZombieConfig.Decomposition: Effect of time decomposition on zombie strength and speed.
dictionary.ZombieConfig.Sight: Zombie vision level (daylight, night vision, normal).
dictionary.ZombieConfig.Hearing: Zombie hearing level (very sharp, normal, deaf).
dictionary.DayLength: Real-life duration of a full in-game day.
dictionary.StartMonth: Month of the year when the apocalypse begins.
dictionary.StartDay: Day of the month when the game starts.
dictionary.StartTime: Time of day when the game starts.
dictionary.WaterShut: Time it takes for running water to be cut off.
dictionary.ElecShut: Time it takes for the city power grid to shut down.
dictionary.NightDarkness: How dark the nights will be (pitch black, bright, etc.).
dictionary.LootRespawn: How often items regenerate inside already-looted containers.
dictionary.MultiplierConfig.XPMultiplier: Global experience gain multiplier for all skills.
dictionary.Nutrition: Enables the carbs, fats, and calories system that affects character weight.
dictionary.StarterKit: If enabled, the player spawns with a starter bag containing food, basic tools, and a water bottle.
dictionary.CarSpawnRate: How often vehicles appear on the streets.
dictionary.ChanceHasGas: Probability that a car has gas when found.
dictionary.InitialGas: Initial amount of gas cars will have when they spawn.
dictionary.CarGasConsumption: Fuel consumption multiplier when driving vehicles.
dictionary.LockedHouses: Probability that houses have their doors locked.
dictionary.Alarms: How often houses have active alarms when forced entry is attempted.
dictionary.AllowDestructionByAdmin: Allows administrators to destroy structures with tools.
